<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  const triggers = document.querySelectorAll(
    'a[href="#product-info-container"], c-sticky-atc .inner-container div.c-button'
  );

  // Target the actual ATC button to simulate
  const buyButton = document.querySelector('.cbb-add-to-cart');

  if (!buyButton) return;

  triggers.forEach(function (el) {
    el.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      // Stop default behavior and bubbling
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();

      // Simulate click on the real ATC button
      buyButton.click();
    });
  });
});
</script>
